ECDefaultPrintInfo supplies tooltip and forwards label/onClick to generic Anchor. UIKit DefaultAnchor emits a with optional href and inner span for label. Click prevents default, then invokes callback only when not disabled,optionally debounced. Generic Flexion Anchor also maps Spacebar to onClick. Runtime disabled/layer/popover/metadata state was not inspected.
Anchor onClick dispatches CLICK_PRINT_INFO_ANCHOR_COMMAND with dataKey; eventHandler click map also names that command.

FlexionAnchorPrintInfoPlugin registers command,sets is_shaded=true and dispatchByEventAsync({dataKey,eventType:print}). Current event binding/action payload/handler implementation and authorization are not captured.
